recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless future Pharmacy work changes the Medication.doseForm examples or the packaging model.
issue_request: FHIR-11182 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from DSTU2 asking to remove "carton" from the Medication.product.form description/examples because a carton is packaging, not a medicinal product form.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 6b3299e7a160e1ce648af924105356b12ab597cc, which changed the Medication product form short label and definition from "powder | tablets | carton" / "Powder; tablets; carton" to "powder | tablets | capsule" / "Powder; tablets; capsule" in the then-current Medication spreadsheet source.
additional_context: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current element is Medication.doseForm in source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml. Its short and definition still list powder, tablets, and capsule, not carton. Remaining current Medication-related carton references are package displays or medication-definition packaging narrative. FHIR-9142 is a related earlier Published/Persuasive clarification of the ordered/dispensed/administered form context and does not reintroduce carton as a dose form. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already preserves the FHIR-11182 correction and the remaining carton references are appropriate packaging contexts.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive clarification establishing Medication.product.form context; it remains compatible with the carton-removal decision.
